name: keyburn
description: KeyBurn: zero-knowledge, self-destructing secret sharing on Cloudflare, with a CLI and MCP server for AI agents.

scripts.dev: npm run build && OSSS_DEV=1 wrangler dev --port 8787 --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/cli/tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e: node e2e/run.mjs && node e2e/cli.mjs && node e2e/a11y.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build:verify
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run e2e && env -u OSSS_DEV wrangler deploy
